title: [spec-gap][R-02-006] Rust SX1262 paths never program sync word 0x34 (spec 02 3.2)
description: Req R-02-006 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.2): Sync Word MUST be 0x34, distinct from Meshtastic 0x2B. DIVERGENT (half-fixed): C LR1110 now programs 0x34 unconditionally (lichen/drivers/lora/lr1110/lr1110.c:502-504, lora_l2.c:306-308, comment 'R-02-006'). But Rust: LORA_SYNC_WORD=0x34 defined at rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs:4 with ZERO consumers — lichen-embassy SX1262 drivers (esp32s3.rs, stm32wl.rs) never set a sync word; lora-phy default is uncontrolled. Interop-critical: Rust nodes would not hear C nodes. Also no test in any stack pins 0x34 on a real modem. Suggested placement: lichen-embassy radio config (set sync word from LORA_SYNC_WORD) + a host-side constant test.
